notes.title: Instructions for rolling back the version update on the 14th to the 12th
notes.notes:
The 14th version mainly solves the level BUG, ​​but causes the level to be blocked when new files are created.

Therefore, the updated version on the 14th has been rolled back to the version on the 12th, and we sincerely apologize for the problems caused by all new players.

Players who have already downloaded the game should update the game or check the integrity of the game, and update back to the 12th version to play the game.

notes.title: Game update 1212

1 Solved the problem that side characters would die in levels without KC players

notes.title: Game Update 12.5
notes.notes:
Game Update
1 Now you can use the keyboard to learn martial arts in battle (free up everyone's right hand XDX)
2 Fixed the bug of saving and inheriting, and now the saving can correctly inherit the cultivation of the Star Absorbing Technique
3 Greatly reduced the upgrade cost of the Star Absorbing Technique, and now it is very easy to upgrade
4 Greatly reduced the attributes of the final hidden BOSS
5 Slightly improved the attributes of the Ludongtang zombie
6 Modified the login cover (some students said it was not sharp enough)

If some details and problems that need to be optimized are found, they will still be updated, if not, they will not be updated so frequently

notes.title: Game Update 11.30
notes.notes:
Game Update 11.30

1 Increased the total time of a single game to 90 days

2 Canceled the death setting of side characters

3 Fixed the problem of occasional inability to enter the level

4 In the H plot stage, the operation button panel is added to the right hand side, and the H plot can now be automatically fast-forwarded.

5 Modified the game save file, and the second round can now inherit attributes

6 Optimized the game save file, and now the unlocked character avatars can be seen in the new save file

7 Fixed the bug that some special effects cannot be displayed normally

8 Fixed the problem that some players cannot see all the illustrations

9 The H plot recall function has been added to the illustration function, so you can now review the H plot

10 The unlocking condition prompt has been added to the recall plot



Please note that due to the modification of save-related functions, some functions will only take effect if you open a new save or start a new game. Thank you for your support and understanding.
